note: The canonical figure registry for the book. Each entry names one editable PlantUML source and the generated SVG asset that book sources may embed. A figure that belongs to a study keeps its source in that study (the study source stays canonical); the book's own figures keep their source under book/assets/sources/. book/assets/export.sh --write renders every source with the pinned renderer and writes book/assets/figure-manifest.json; the build runs --check and fails on a missing asset, a changed source or a stale render.
